notes: Search for dark photon (and axion) DM resonant conversion in the solar corona using LOFAR radio data at 30-80 MHz (m_A' ~ 1.2e-7 to 3.3e-7 eV). Paper reports epsilon ~ 1e-13 upper limit across the band; precise per-frequency values must be read from Fig. 4 which was not available numerically. Data points here are approximate representative values along the ~1e-13 limit curve spanning the mass range corresponding to 30-80 MHz. The paper also derives an axion-photon coupling limit (Fig. 10) but explicitly states the dark photon case is the main result; that limit is weaker than existing bounds.
